svg.title: Continuity in the character is obtained from translation pairings. The characteristic function of the scalar spectral measure νχ of a fixed sum of words is the inner product of that vector with its translated vector. Both vectors are represented by fixed words with the same transported labels, so the continuum table’s word-pair continuity gives continuity in χ at each translation. The total masses νχ(total) have a common bound M. For a compact smooth momentum test g, Fourier R g dνχ as a fixed Fourier normalization times the integral of the characteristic inversion writes function against the Schwartz function hat(g).
